title: A user WITH Work Orders access sees Work Order results in the palette
A user WITH Customers access sees Customer and Asset results in the palette
A user WITH Part Sales access sees Part Sale results in the palette
A user WITH Vendor & Order Management access sees Vendor, Purchase Order and Vendor Invoice results
A user WITH See Financial Data sees prices in search result rows
A prefix name match ranks above a whole-word match, which ranks above a fuzzy match
Customers with an open work order and recently viewed rank higher
Assets with an open work order (and recently viewed) rank higher
Vendors with open purchase orders (and recently used) rank higher
Recent part sales, yours, and paid ones rank higher
Recently sold and recently viewed parts rank higher
A very short query does not produce noisy fuzzy matches
